shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'
/bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' -g '"'!*dist*'"' -g '"'!*build*'"' | head -80"

/bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json && cat src/App.tsx && cat src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md'

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/icons.md && cat tsconfig.json'

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/README.md'

/bin/bash -lc 'cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/{Button/Button,Select/Select,Modal/Modal,DropdownMenu/DropdownMenu,TextInput/TextInput}.d.ts && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/types | head -25'

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,145p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts && rg -n -A 95 'CSS API' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs/components/AsideHeader.md && rg -n 'ChartData|ChartProps|ChartAxis|AreaSeries|PieSeries' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/index.d.ts && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist | rg '(axis|area|pie|chart|series).*\\.d.ts"'$'"' | head -35 && rg -n 'Layout|Chart|Bell|Gear|ArrowUpRight|Calendar|Plus|Person|Grip|Ellipsis|Folder|Magnifier|Check|Xmark|Sliders|ArrowDown|CircleQuestion|Clock|ArrowRight|Chevron|Target|Shopping|Globe|Database|Book' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/index.d.ts | head -80 && rg -n 'size\\??|options\\??|value\\??|onUpdate\\??|filterable\\??|placeholder\\??' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -25"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/{theming,axes/axis-labels}.md && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist | rg '/(Chart|chart-data|axis|area|pie|series).*d.ts"'$'"' | head -50 && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | rg '(TextInput.*d.ts|DropdownMenu/types.d.ts)'"

/bin/bash -lc "ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/*{Layout,Chart,Bell,Gear,ArrowUpRight,Calendar,Plus,Person,Grip,Ellipsis,Folder,Magnifier,Check,Xmark,Sliders,ArrowDown,CircleQuestion,Clock,ArrowRight,Chevron,Target,Shopping,Globe,Database,Book}*d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -75; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/index.d.ts; rg -n 'export (interface|type) (ChartData|ChartProps|AreaSeries|PieSeries|XAxis|YAxis)' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -20; rg -n 'value\\??|onUpdate\\??|size\\??|options\\??|filterable\\??|placeholder\\??' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts | head -28; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/DropdownMenu/types.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'tick|grid|labels|visible|min\\??|max\\??|format' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | head -55; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/chart.d.ts | head -75; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts | rg -n -A 5 'dash|lineWidth|marker|interpol'; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit | rg '\\.css"'$'"' | head -8; rg -n 'width|expanded' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -10"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '40,85p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts; sed -n '210,260p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts; sed -n '1,60p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/chart.d.ts; rg -n -A 5 'dash' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts; rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit | rg '\\.css"'$'"' | head -5; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/index.js | head -18"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '168,210p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts; nl -ba src/App.tsx | sed -n '67,73p'; rg -n 'draggableHandleClassName|draggableHandle|noOverlay' node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/{GridLayout,DashKit,GridItem} -g '*.js' | head -30; rg -n -o '.{0,60}gn-aside-header-size.{0,100}' node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.css | head -5; cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
p='src/App.tsx'
s=open(p).read().replace('ticks:{positions:', 'ticks:{values:').replace('kinds.includes(i.data.kind)','kinds.includes(String(i.data.kind))')

s=s.replace(\"const exportReport=()=>{const csv='\\\\uFEFFМетрика;Значение\\\\nВыручка;1245800\\\\nЗаказы;1842\\\\nПосетители;48256\\\\nКонверсия;3,82%'\", \"const exportReport=()=>{const factor=period==='week'?.27:period==='quarter'?2.83:1;const csv="'`'"\\\\uFEFFМетрика;Значение\\\\nВыручка;"'${Math.round(1245800*factor)}'"\\\\nЗаказы;"'${Math.round(1842*factor)}'"\\\\nПосетители;"'${Math.round(48256*factor)}'"\\\\nКонверсия;3,82%"'`")
